explication: This repository is a portable knowledge pack for AI assistants developing WordPress projects, not a WordPress runtime. The main workflow is that an assistant uses the router and, where needed, project triage to select focused guidance; that skill then informs implementation, review, or operations. Skills cover distinct WordPress domains, with specialized audit and verification stages for the Abilities API. A small set of scripts supplies project-detection and inspection data to relevant workflows. The README documents broader capabilities than the sampled source excerpts, so links among unsampled skill internals are not inferred.
